skills.name: avoid-ai-writing
skills.description: Audit and rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns (AI-isms). Use when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit writing for AI patterns, audit writing for AI tells, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, an edit-in-place mode, optional voice profiles, and an iterate-to-convergence pass.

skills.name: anti-ai-writing
skills.description: Voice and style guide for writing like a sharp, specific human. Use when drafting or editing prose to enforce varied sentence rhythm, natural contractions, direct address, and a list of anti-AI-tell rules so copy stops reading as machine-generated.

skills.name: seo-audit-report
skills.description: Evidence-driven SEO audit of static code repositories across 24 audit pillars, including technical SEO, semantic SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, competitor analysis, IndexNow, and E-E-A-T. Use when asked to audit a site or codebase and produce a prioritized seo_audit_report.md with CSV export.
